reason: A WeChat integration that remotely controls a dsh agent, supports session management, file transfer, and proactive notifications; human review is appropriate because full-permission execution is enabled by default and messages traverse an external service.

summaries.zh: 通过微信远程控制 dsh 智能体，支持会话切换、双向文件传输和任务完成通知。
summaries.en: Control a dsh agent remotely through WeChat with session switching, two-way file transfer, and task completion notifications.

capabilities: Remote control of an agent through WeChat messages
Execution of agent tasks with full-permission mode by default
Two-way file transfer between WeChat and workspace directories
Proactive text and file notifications to WeChat
Storage and use of WeChat gateway credentials
Transmission of messages through Tencent iLink servers
